replay: flow replay of the normalized and stable-local groups

stageKinds.producer: the stage must end ok; its output feeds later stages
stageKinds.observation: the stage is expected to end as a complete capture of a child that ended nonzero, carrying exactly the declared native diagnostic at the declared source location; any signal, unrelated diagnostic, missing output or capture failure does not match
stageKinds.check: the stage must end ok; it verifies identity, closure, comparison or membership

dependencies.dependsOn: every listed stage must end ok before this stage runs; otherwise this stage is recorded as not-reached
dependencies.observes: this stage examines the complete recorded result of the listed stage, including a declared observation, and is not blocked by it

hashed: tests/support/stage-check.sh when this revision carries it
excluded: reference/**: no generation entry of these groups names it
packages/registry/**: no generation entry of these groups names it
tests/ts, tests/kotlin, tests/rust, tests/dart, tests/vectors: verification trees, not generation inputs
tools other than tools/bundle: verification and repository tooling, not generation inputs
examples/**, docs/**: not read by these entries
inputClosure.note: the class-path roots are hashed whole, so the closure covers the declared inputs of the entries and not only the modules the entry classes reach

verdictMeaning.unexpectedFailures: declared stages that did not reach their declared outcome, captures that do not hold, stage sets that do not match, and measured sequences that differ from the authored sequence in any way other than the one documented replacement
verdictMeaning.recordedObservations: the declared native rejections and differences of this fixture; each is a source and target nonconformance observation that stays retained and never counts as an agreement
verdictMeaning.acceptance: the attempt is accepted only when unexpectedFailures is zero
